text:
Priya: quick thread / small hello-world quickstart refresh. focusing on lowering first-deploy friction + clarifying auth choices. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4417
Owen: can you summarize the visible changes to the Quickstart?
Priya: sure. 1) 'Before you begin' checklist (REDWOOD_TOKEN, PROJECT_REGION, minimal role). 2) browser-friendly ephemeral token snippet replacing long-lived API key in the demo. 3) tiny troubleshooting section for common first-deploy errors.
Lina: important: add one-line caveat that ephemeral tokens are for demos/browser flows only; point to /guides/security for production patterns.
Priya: adding that now: "For production or Private deployments, prefer KMS-backed JWTs or server-signed tokens (see /guides/security)."
marco: CI link-checker flagged /deploy#auth-faq as missing. use /deploy#troubleshooting instead.
ci-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link -> /deploy#auth-faq (404)
Priya: fixed anchors and pushed.
Owen: what about SDK versions? we recently landed auth.getEphemeralToken() in v8.1.0. should examples be pinned?
Priya: yes, pinning sample package.json to "@redwood/sdk": "^8.1.0" and adding a note: "Snippets assume sdk v8.1+."
Lina: tiny snippet nit: use `ttl` and clarify units. proposed snippet:
```js
// sample pinned to @redwood/sdk@^8.1.0
const token = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttl: 60 }) // ttl in seconds
await fetch('/api/start', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
```
marco: also remove unused imports in the sample app (node-fetch) to quiet lint. and prefer logger over console to satisfy lint rules.
Priya: will remove unused import and swap console -> logger.
Owen: add a "Before you begin" bullet about PROJECT_REGION or the deploy script errors silently. many new users hit that.
Priya: added a preflight checklist with PROJECT_REGION + REDWOOD_TOKEN + minimal IAM role.
Lina: update screenshots: env var label changed from REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN. please regenerate.
Priya: will capture fresh screenshots after the final pass.
marco: add a short auth troubleshooting blurb: 401 -> check clock skew and expired ephemeral token; 403 -> role/permission missing. keeps support volume down.
Priya: added a two-line troubleshooting section.
ci-bot: docs-build passed; link-checker re-run -> 0 broken links.
Owen: LGTM pending screenshot refresh and lint fix.
Priya: pushing the screenshot and lint fixes momentarily. will ping when CI is green. :rocket:
